item.title: Movie Review: In ‘Fatherland,’ Paweł Pawlikowski’s austere portrait of a fractured Germany

item.title: US jobless claims fell to 194,000 last week, lowest since July
item.description: U.S. unemployment claims fell to 194,000 last week, the fewest in three months and another sign that layoffs remain low and most Americans enjoy extraordinary job security.

item.title: France reports first human case of livestock virus Shamonda in patient who later died
item.description: France has detected the first human case of the Shamonda virus, according to health authorities. The case involved a severely immunocompromised patient in Lyon who died in early October.
